title: A free trick with the ace of Hearts

feedback.title: Take the free trick
feedback.summary: As the last card in this trick, the ace of Hearts beats everything already played and secures a trick your target still needs.
points: No card already played can beat an ace, and no one plays after you this trick.
The target needs three more tricks from the four remaining; this one is guaranteed if you take it.
Taking it now converts an already-decided trick into progress toward the target, rather than leaving that progress to a later, unresolved trick.

feedback.title: Giving away a guaranteed trick
feedback.summary: Playing the three lets the eight of Hearts win instead, and the target still needs three of the remaining four tricks.
points: The trick is already decided by whichever card you choose; this specific trick will not come back for the ace to win later.
The target still needs three of the remaining four tricks, so this trick should not be given away.
Whichever Heart you keep is played in a later trick regardless; keeping the ace back does not change how this trick is decided right now.

author_notes: First reviewed play scenario: recognizing a guaranteed trick when acting last. Winner resolution is not implemented; the app does not compute this automatically yet.
